edits.value_json: {"text":"The received-form account preserved in Shuowen and 字源 interprets 包 as pregnancy: 勹 wraps or encloses 巳, understood as an unborn child, together conveying 胞衣. 字源 calls 包 a 会意字. Its page labels a glyph sequence 《说文》小篆, 秦, 睡甲, 汉, 《篆隶表》, and 楷书; these labels do not authenticate the displayed forms as dated artifacts.","evidence_ids":["ref003","ref061","ref070","ref071"]}
